LESSON: MULTIPLICATION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.6: Multiplication

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Multiplication. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-054.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 54]]

From your pupil's book (page 54)

Activity 1 Write using the ‘’ sign There are 2 groups each with 4 objects. and

and and There are 3 groups each with 2 objects This is the same as 3 x 2. Work to do Write the sign ‘’ or the missing number

1. and and is the same as 3 ______ 4 2. and is the same as 2 ______ 3

1. and is 3 + ________ = ________ 2. and is

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-112.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 112]]

From your pupil's book (page 112)

NUMBERS MULTIPLICATION Week 6 Lesson 4 Multiply Activity Multiply by 2

and is 3 + 3 = 6 There are 2 groups each with 3 objects, giving 6 objects

Work to do Multiply 1. 2x1 = 2. 2x2= 3. 2x3= 4. 2x4= 5. 2x5= 6. 2x6= 7. 2x7 8. 2x8= 9. 2x9=

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Multiplication means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Multiplication.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Multiplication
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
